accepted_parent.scope: one aircraft and three separate fixed two-hour missions at h8-10/h20-22/h32-34, seed1, no ordinary failures, horizon36

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp192-193 and 437-439: DAMP is per-mission occurrence probability, at most one occurrence per type per mission, and occurrence time is sampled within the mission. DAMRT is a separate rate; the child leaves it null. DamageItem.PROB=0 specifies no attrition consequence.
source_delta: The control is byte-identical to accepted A02. The child adds BATTLE-HIT DamageType, MissionDamage DAMP=0.5/DAMRT=null and DamageItem <ATTRITION>/PROB=0; only ProblemDescription changes among existing tables. Mission schedule, seed, system and horizon remain identical.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The native control should convert with zero errors, log no damage and complete all three missions, with 72 aligned System/Stock bins and six aircraft-hours.
pre_run_hypotheses.intermediate: If seed1 yields both a DAMP occurrence and a non-occurrence across the three missions, the log should show one or two BATTLE-HIT events, no more than one within each h8-10/h20-22/h32-34 mission and none during preparation. Both occurrence and non-occurrence must be visible; exact event count, mission identity and sampled time are not preaccepted. With PROB=0, all missions should succeed and the aircraft remain ready.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, zero or three events, repeated same-type events in one mission, prelaunch event, attrition or abort are diagnostic only for this proposed intermediate-probability contrast. No seed search or post-run acceptance threshold adjustment is allowed.

acceptance_gates: Independent static review of frozen source, exact diff, installed manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 13/16 authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid native logs/reports
Control no damage; child mixed one/two per-mission occurrences, no more than one per mission, no prelaunch event, all missions succeed and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: One seed and three Bernoulli opportunities show a bounded realized pattern, not calibration of the 0.5 probability, statistical independence or a population timing law.
The zero-probability consequence does not test attrition, item/system damage or repair; other probabilities, formation sizes, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
